title: Pokemon Radical Red
description: A famously challenging enhancement hack of FireRed featuring Pokémon from Gen 1 to Gen 9, Mega Evolutions, highly competitive AI, and built-in randomizer modes.

title: Pokemon Unbound
description: Set in the historical Borrius region, this hack features a custom story, complex puzzles, Gen 8 mechanics, and a highly customizable difficulty system.

title: Pokemon Gaia
description: Explore the Orbtus region, uncovering a rich lore surrounding an ancient civilization. Features Gen 6 mechanics, Mega Evolutions, and hidden grottos.

title: Pokemon Glazed
description: Travel across the Tunod, Johto, and Rankor regions in this massive adventure featuring dream world elements, five starters, and Pokémon up to Gen 6.

title: Pokemon Light Platinum
description: A legendary GBA hack that completely overhauls the game with new regions (Zhery and Lauren), graphical updates, and leaders from across the franchise.

title: Pokemon Prism
description: A remarkable GBC hack where you play as Lance's child exploring the Naljo region. Features a custom engine, new types (Gas and Sound), and crafting.

title: Pokemon Crystal Clear
description: An open-world hack of Pokémon Crystal. Start in Johto or Kanto, pick from 24 starters, and challenge gyms in any order with level-scaling.

title: Pokemon Renegade Platinum
description: Drayano's definitive enhancement hack of Platinum. All 493 Pokémon are available, trainers are much harder, and classes/moves have been rebalanced.

title: Pokemon Blaze Black
description: A difficulty and availability hack of Pokémon Black by Drayano. Access all 649 Pokémon, face tougher gym leaders, and experience edited stats/moves.

title: Pokemon Volt White
description: The companion hack to Blaze Black, offering the same difficulty enhancements and complete Pokédex availability for the White version.

title: Pokemon Blaze Black 2
description: The sequel to Blaze Black, upgrading Black 2 with incredible challenge, rebalanced mechanics, and all Pokémon available without trading.

title: Pokemon Volt White 2
description: The sequel to Volt White, giving White 2 the signature Drayano treatment with higher difficulty and an expanded catchable roster.

title: Pokemon Sacred Gold
description: An enhancement of HeartGold by Drayano. Features all 493 Pokémon, scripted legendary events, removed trade evolutions, and increased difficulty.

title: Pokemon Storm Silver
description: The counterpart to Sacred Gold, bringing the same expansive roster, difficulty spikes, and quality of life changes to SoulSilver.

title: Pokemon Liquid Crystal
description: A massive GBA remake of Pokémon Crystal on the FireRed engine. Includes Johto, Kanto, and the Orange Islands with modern mechanics.

title: Pokemon AshGray
description: Play exactly through the events of the original Pokémon anime. Replaces Red with Ash and perfectly mimics the show's first 50 episodes.

title: Pokemon Flora Sky
description: An older but iconic GBA hack featuring a custom region, Pokémon up to Gen 5, day/night cycles, and legendary events.

title: Pokemon Snakewood
description: A bizarre and famous zombie apocalypse hack of Ruby. Features custom zombie Pokémon sprites, a dark storyline, and high difficulty.

title: Pokemon Rocket Edition
description: Play as a Team Rocket grunt in Kanto. Steal Pokémon, rise through the ranks, and uncover the dark conspiracies hiding behind the original Gen 1 plot.

title: Pokemon Emerald Kaizo
description: One of the most brutally difficult Pokémon hacks ever created. Specifically designed to challenge hardcore Nuzlockers with vicious AI and limited encounters.

title: Pokemon Platinum Kaizo
description: A mercilessly hard enhancement of Platinum meant to break even the most experienced players. Heavily limits healing and setup sweeping.

title: Pokemon Crystal Kaizo
description: A highly punishing Gen 2 hack that overhauls boss battles, wild encounters, and item availability to create a grueling Johto experience.

title: Pokemon Blue Kaizo
description: Redesigns Kanto into a maze of high-level trainers and devious puzzles, staying true to Gen 1 mechanics while maximizing difficulty.

title: Pokemon Polished Crystal
description: A massive quality of life update to Crystal. Adds the physical/special split, fairy type, running shoes, and expanded storylines without losing the Gen 2 feel.

title: Pokemon Adventure Red Chapter
description: Follows the exact storyline of the Pokémon Adventures manga. Features incredible custom art, level caps, and multiple massive regions.

title: Pokemon Clover
description: A high-quality 4chan imageboard hack featuring 386 completely original (and often offensive) Fakemon, surprisingly deep lore, and high difficulty.

title: Pokemon Orange Islands
description: Explore the Orange Archipelago from the anime. Features 4 gym leaders, the Orange Crew, and a faithful recreation of Ash's journey.

title: Pokemon Sovereign of the Skies
description: A German hack translated to English featuring a deep, narrative-driven story with completely custom graphics and an incredible soundtrack.

title: Pokemon Sors
description: A Gen 7 style Eclipse mechanic hack set in the Hupest region. Focuses heavily on story and a brand new type mechanic.

title: Pokemon Saiph
description: The prequel to Pokémon Sors. Features mechanics from Gen 4/5/6 and a dark storyline involving Team Royal.

title: Pokemon GS Chronicles
description: A stunning visual remake of HeartGold/SoulSilver for the GBA featuring Mega Evolution, Z-moves, and an expanded Johto narrative.

title: Pokemon Inclement Emerald
description: A modern enhancement of Emerald similar to Radical Red. Features Pokémon up to Gen 7, mega evolutions, customized difficulty, and full decapitalization.

title: Pokemon Photonic Sun
description: An enhancement hack of Ultra Sun. Completely removes trade evolutions, spikes the difficulty, and rebalances the Alola region for veteran players.

title: Pokemon Prismatic Moon
description: The sister hack to Photonic Sun, providing the same challenging, definitive way to play through the Ultra Moon campaign.

title: Pokemon Penumbra Moon
description: A rebalance and difficulty hack for the base Pokémon Moon game. Overhauls trainer rosters and allows all Pokémon to be caught legitimately.

title: Pokemon Supernova Sun
description: The companion to Penumbra Moon, giving the base Pokémon Sun game a competitive edge and expansive wild encounter lists.

title: Pokemon Rutile Ruby
description: A 3DS hack of Omega Ruby featuring an overhauled level curve, completely revamped trainer AI, and access to all 721 Pokémon.

title: Pokemon Star Sapphire
description: A 3DS hack of Alpha Sapphire bringing extreme difficulty to Hoenn. Designed for players who find modern official games too easy.

title: Pokemon Moon Black 2
description: A crossover hack bringing Gen 7 Pokémon, Alolan forms, and characters from Sun/Moon into the Nintendo DS Black 2 engine.

title: Pokemon Shiny Gold Sigma
description: An incredibly ambitious GBA remake of Johto spanning into Kanto, the Orange Islands, and Hoenn, featuring over 800 Pokémon.

title: Pokemon Ultra Shiny Gold Sigma
description: The updated successor to Shiny Gold Sigma, fixing bugs and adding Gen 8 mechanics, Mega Evolution, and Z-Moves to the massive map.

title: Pokemon Nameless FireRed Project
description: A purist, feature-rich hack of FireRed that adds hidden abilities, Gen 4-6 moves, and an expanded roster while keeping the base story intact.

title: Pokemon Mega Power
description: Play as a scientist working for a sinister organization to create the strongest Mewtwo. Features three regions: Ivara, Lander, and Sevii.

title: Pokemon Resolute
description: Set in the Sylon and Tyron regions. The protagonist must stop an evil organization from mutating Pokémon. Features Mega Evolutions.

title: Pokemon Victory Fire
description: Set in the Tyron region. Features an expansive story involving Team Mirage, custom sprites, and a blend of classic and modern mechanics.

title: Pokemon Coral
description: A beautiful GBC-style hack pushing the limits of the engine. Features a unique, vibrant region, 60fps support, and highly polished custom sprites.

title: Pokemon ROWE
description: An open-world recreation of Pokémon Emerald. Tackle gym leaders in any order with full level-scaling and extensive quality of life upgrades.

title: Pokemon Theta Emerald EX
description: One of the first hacks to successfully stuff 721 Pokémon, 600+ moves, and Fairy typing into the Emerald engine.

title: Pokemon Theta Emerald Renev
description: The definitive sequel to EX, fixing major bugs, updating sprites, and bringing the total catchable roster to 721 with modern mechanics.

title: Pokemon Dark Rising
description: An infamous GBA hack known for its punishing level curve, mature storyline, and requirement for extensive grinding to progress.
